stages.title: Life cycle

leads.idea: Why the product is worth building: what is known, what is believed and what is waiting to settle.
leads.requirements: What the product must do, as its user sees it: the statements the product is held to.
leads.design: How the system will do it: the intent drawn before code and the choices taken about why.
leads.build: What is being built and where it stands: the code repositories and the product tasks, grouped by feature, read from the tracker.
leads.verify: What was accepted and how it was proven: the stage records with their revisions and checks.
leads.release: What reached its users and when: the release notes and the versions.
leads.operate: What failed in use and what it changed: the incidents’ timeline, the cost, what was filed.
